To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the flux of metabolites depend on the enzyme activity, that the activity depends on the enzyme kinetics and the substrate concentration and that the kinetic data can be used to model metabolic networks.
the kinetic properties of enzymes can be measured in a systematic way and that these data can be incorporated in metabolic models to improve our understanding of the flux of metabolites.
we have developed the first comprehensive model for the allocation of carbon and nitrogen to the protein of a living organism.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the measurement of enzyme activity, with the development of mathematical models for enzyme kinetics, and with the application of these models in metabolic flux analysis.
the development of new methods to determine the kinetics of enzymes in a high-throughput fashion and the use of the resulting data for the construction of kinetic models of metabolic networks.
the development of methods to measure the kinetics and regulation of enzymes and their use to understand the metabolic network.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the metabolic models of protein allocation call for the kinetome.
the kinetic properties of the enzymes of a given organism are not yet well enough known to be used as the basis of metabolic models of protein allocation.
the kinetome is a prerequisite for a comprehensive metabolic model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new approach for measuring the kinetics of enzymes.
the kinetome is the next frontier of metabolic engineering.
we are developing and testing the concept of kinetomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need the kinetome, the comprehensive set of enzyme kinetics data, to build predictive models of the cell.
we can use the kinetic data to build models of protein allocation in the cell.
the kinetics of enzymes in living cells is a major challenge that needs to be addressed in order to understand metabolism.
